Justin Cole Mossa

Justin Cole Mossa is a New York based writer-director-producer-designer and founder & CEO of Arondyte Pictures. Justin is a highly visual storyteller, who is driven by a strong vision. He’s a supportive collaborator, who leads with a sense of purpose and where everyone feels heard.

Justin Cole Mossa has a BFA from NYU Tisch School of the Arts and was born and raised in Connecticut. His body of work consists of thrillers, sci-fi, dramas, and supernatural fiction.

He pairs over three years of operations logistics at a global cultural institution with over five years of on-set independent production experience.
